newsitem.title: UK: UK natural gas spot prices firmer in prompt.
newsitem.headline: UK natural gas spot prices firmer in prompt.

text.p: U.K. spot natural gas prices were steady to stronger on Monday across the curve and business was busiest in the prompt period, traders said.
A large end user bought around two million therms per day on June 10 and 11 and paid between 11.2 and 11.3 pence per therm.
Further out, prices were also slightly stronger and activity was mostly seen in the third and fourth quarters.

Around 75,000 therms per day was traded for the third quarter at between 10.10 and 10.30 pence per therm, while around 125,000 therms per day were heard traded at between 13.40 and 13.45 pence per therm.
"The prompt is likely to come off tomorrow unless there is action on the flexibility market overnight," one broker said.
The IPE natural gas contract was busier in the morning. A total of 45 lots were traded - with October done at 12.40 pence per therm, December done at 14.60 pence and January 1998 done at 17.775.
"It's a bit more encouraging," one broker at the IPE said, but added "It its still going slowly, slowly."
